definition.simple: Beating a harvested plant to get the seeds out of their covers.
definition.academic: Threshing is the process of loosening the edible part of grain (or other crop) from the chaff to which it is attached. It is done after harvesting and before winnowing.

examples: Beating stalks of wheat on a hard surface
Using a threshing machine to separate grain

common_misconceptions: Threshing completely cleans the grain. (It only separates it from the stalk, chaff is still mixed in).
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask the student: If you have a peanut in a shell, how do you get the nut out? You break it. Threshing is breaking the 'shell' of the grain!
